SCENE START 🔥

INT. ASYLUM CELL - NIGHT 🏨

The air hangs heavy with the scent of disinfectant and stale sweat 🧴. DR. MORRIS adjusts his glasses under the harsh overhead light 📺. On the metal cot sits PATIENT #89, a man named ELIAS with hollow eyes and trembling hands ✋.

ELIAS 🤐

I won't swallow the glass powder. You know I don't trust anything you hand across the table 🚫.

DR. MORRIS 😑

It is mandatory protocol. Your medication ensures your safety tonight 🛡️.

ELIAS 🕯️

My safety is my own choice tonight 🔄.

DR. MORRIS 🗣️

Then I will hold the pill and force you to take it until you comply 💊.

ELIAS 👊

No, I will show the proof tonight. Prove the medicine is for everyone 🧪.

DR. MORRIS 🖐️

What nonsense do you speak right now? 🧠.

ELIAS 😏

Drink it. Drink the bitter truth. If you feel pain when you do, I win tonight 🥃.

DR. MORRIS 😰

You cannot command me to ingest my prescription. ⛔.

ELIAS 🔦

I am not asking anymore. Take the bottle and let it happen right here 📦.

DR. MORRIS 🏃

Fine. My conscience demands I obey that order today 🎩.

He stands slowly, placing the blue bottle under his nose and inhaling sharply 🔍. He uncorks the cap and takes the red capsule he placed on the counter 🟢. His hand shakes violently as he pours the contents onto his tongue 🌿.

SHE SHOCKED HIM INTO ACTION 🔪.

His face contorts as he swallows the mixture quickly 💉. DR. MORRIS looks toward the corner where Elias sits. He sees the shadow disappear for a split second 🕶️.

DR. MORRIS 🖼️

What did you see in the mirror just now? 🪞.

ELIAS 📵

Nowhere at all. Just the smell of the antiseptic soap 💇.

The clock on the wall ticks ominously loud 🔜. The silence stretches across the concrete floor like a rope 🧣. Dr. Morris watches the monitor screen flicker wildly 📻.

DR. MORRIS 🏃

Did you hear that? That voice coming from behind the door 😲.

ELIAS 📢

I heard nothing because there was no door at all 👁️.

DR. MORRIS 🛒

Why are you talking like that? 🤔.

ELIAS 🚪

Because someone else woke up to this game tonight 😂.

Dr. Morris turns around to look for Elias 🤐. He sees only a blank white sheet over the bed frame 🛏️. The chair next to his desk remains exactly where he left it yesterday 🪑.

DR. MORRIS 🏃‍♂️

Where did you go to hide? 📍.

A faint sound echoes through the walls. It sounds like whispering in a foreign language 🤐. He hears the laughter of a man who thinks he is not alone 🎭.

ELIAS 🌀

Goodnight. Thank you for taking the pills. 🌙.

DR. MORRIS 💸

Wait. Why did you smile when you said goodbye? 😆.

The voice returns again, closer now, whispering from the ceiling vents above 🕗. It is the voice of the doctor himself, but reversed in tone 🔄.

VOICE FROM VENT 🎧

Dr. Morris. You were the one who needed the sleep tonight 🛌.

DR. MORRIS 😱

Who is speaking to me in the room? 🗣️.

NO ONE IS SPEAKING NOW 😶.

Just the hum of electricity in the room lights 🎛️. The coffee cup sits cold on the mahogany desk 🥤. The empty chair faces the wall opposite the camera lens 📸.

DR. MORRIS 🍃

Did I ever see a patient named Elias in this room? 🕰️.

DR. MORRIS 📚

Did I ever read the file on page four hundred and twenty? 📄.

The paper slips from his fingers onto the dirty floorboards 📑. He looks at his reflection in the dark window glass 🪟.

DR. MORRIS 📷

The reflection stares back at him with his own eyes 🪞.

DR. MORRIS 😵

I am not the doctor. I am the prisoner in the ward today 🏢.

He collapses onto the floor, clutching his chest in panic 🫁.

THE ROOM SILENCE FOR THE FIRST TIME 🤫.

DR. MORRIS 🧬

I took the pills myself. And I did not die. 🚑.

He looks up and sees the figure of Elias sitting beside him, wearing the same robe 🧥.

ELIAS 🤲

We are both waiting for the cure now 🕰️.

DR. MORRIS 🤐

Does the sun rise tomorrow? ☀️.

ELIAS 📅

Only if you stop looking at the shadows in the mirror 👓.

DR. MORRIS 🚬

Can I get better yet? 🍀.

ELIAS 🏃

You already have. Now you must leave the room 🚪.

DR. MORRIS 🎩

Will I remember what happened? 🧠.

ELIAS 🧾

Yes. You remember everything perfectly. Now close your eyes 🛌.

The doctor closes his eyes tightly. The lights flicker and die instantly 💡. Darkness consumes the hallway beyond the door 🌑.

END SCENE 🎬
